name: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve
policyReason: No areas are closed to pets; keep them leashed or restrained at all times.
summary: No areas are closed to pets; keep them leashed or restrained at all times.

excerpts.quote: There are no closed areas to pets in Gates of the Arctic National Park & Preserve.

dogRules.text: No pet closures anywhere in the park and preserve.
Sled dogs may be left up to 24 hours with shelter, food and water.
Never leave pets unattended at a public use cabin.
